gate_decision_caveat: Gauge dependence was cleared by A7 v2. This statement is about the gate's invariance, not about whether a given candidate is good: the accept/refuse outcome still needs independent labels before it means anything in B10.

protocol.pose_convention: T_wb (body -> world), matching world_points = pts @ R.T + t
protocol.decision: once per quarantine episode, at t_trigger + confirmation_margin_ns, or at bag end with decision_basis=bag_end
protocol.candidate: host poses recorded during the quarantine (candidate_source=host_poses)
protocol.incumbent: constant-velocity translation extrapolation from the last trusted keyframes, rotation held at the anchor
protocol.what_this_proves: the admission path only -- detect, quarantine, candidate, gate, commit or refuse. Not a re-estimating repairer.
protocol.pre_registered_expectation: on this candidate population the archived four-arm already shows the gate refuses; a run whose gate accepts nothing measures the harmful side of B10 and the refusal half of B5, not the benefit side.

pairing.pairing_rule: nearest pose within 40 ms, no pose reused

pairing_diagnosis.comparability: the offline arms pair at 20 ms; a run at 40 ms is a different pairing and must not be pooled with them in one table

warmup.policy: a frame the node cannot support against its own spatially sampled trusted map is ingested through the manager's healthy path but is NOT judged by the detector; it is recorded as detection_status=UNAVAILABLE. In diagnosis mode (detection=off) every frame is recorded as DISABLED_FOR_DIAGNOSIS and nothing is judged at all.
warmup.not_an_assumption: no frame is labelled healthy; UNAVAILABLE says the detector had no reference, which is a statement about the evidence, not about the frame
